meta.note: Hand-written B1 example sentences for CET entries that lack source examples. Lazy-loaded by review cloze.

acutely.en: He felt the pain acutely after the long climb.
acutely.zh: 长途攀爬后，他敏锐地感到疼痛。

addict.en: Video games can addict young players if they play for hours.
addict.zh: 如果一玩就是几小时，电子游戏可能让年轻人上瘾。

adversely.en: Air pollution can adversely affect children's health.
adversely.zh: 空气污染会对儿童健康产生不利影响。

affiliation.en: Please write your school affiliation on the form.
affiliation.zh: 请在表格上填写你所属的学校。

afflict.en: Drought continues to afflict farmers in the dry region.
afflict.zh: 干旱继续折磨着干旱地区的农民。

allied.en: The two allied countries worked together on the project.
allied.zh: 这两个盟国在该项目上合作。

alternatively.en: You can walk there, or alternatively take the bus.
alternatively.zh: 你可以走着去，或者改坐公交。

analogous.en: Learning a language is analogous to learning to swim.
analogous.zh: 学习语言类似于学习游泳。

armor.en: The knight wore heavy armor before the battle.
armor.zh: 骑士在战前穿上了沉重的盔甲。

assimilation.en: Cultural assimilation can take many years for new immigrants.
assimilation.zh: 对新移民来说，文化同化可能需要许多年。

blond.en: The blond boy with blue eyes waved from the window.
blond.zh: 那个金发碧眼的男孩在窗边招手。

boiler.en: The building's boiler broke down on the coldest night.
boiler.zh: 大楼的锅炉在最冷的夜晚坏了。

bridle.en: She held the horse's bridle firmly as it grew nervous.
bridle.zh: 马紧张时，她紧紧抓住马笼头。

brightness.en: The brightness of the screen hurt his eyes.
brightness.zh: 屏幕的亮度刺痛了他的眼睛。

buffalo.en: A large buffalo stood quietly near the river bank.
buffalo.zh: 一头大水牛静静地站在河岸边。

burner.en: Turn the gas burner down before the soup boils over.
burner.zh: 在汤溢出来之前把煤气灶火关小。

capacitance.en: The engineer measured the capacitance of the new circuit.
capacitance.zh: 工程师测量了新电路的电容。

casualty.en: The accident caused one serious casualty and two minor injuries.
casualty.zh: 事故造成一人重伤、两人轻伤。

chronically.en: He has been chronically late for morning meetings.

chunk.en: She cut a thick chunk of bread for her sandwich.
chunk.zh: 她切了一大块面包做三明治。

cocaine.en: Police found illegal cocaine hidden in the truck.
cocaine.zh: 警方在卡车里发现了藏匿的非法可卡因。

coffin.en: Friends carried the wooden coffin to the quiet cemetery.
coffin.zh: 朋友们抬着木棺走向安静的墓地。

conclusive.en: The DNA test provided conclusive proof of his innocence.
conclusive.zh: DNA检测提供了他无罪的确凿证据。

correlate.en: Smoking is a known correlate of many heart problems.
correlate.zh: 吸烟是许多心脏问题的已知相关因素。

counselor.en: She talked to a school counselor about her future plans.
counselor.zh: 她找学校咨询顾问讨论了未来规划。

crab.en: We caught a live crab and cooked it for dinner.
crab.zh: 我们抓到一只活蟹，做成了晚餐。

datum.en: Each datum in the table must be checked carefully.
datum.zh: 表格中的每一条数据都必须仔细核对。

degeneration.en: Lack of exercise can lead to muscle degeneration.
degeneration.zh: 缺乏锻炼可能导致肌肉退化。

delusion.en: He lived under the delusion that he would never grow old.
delusion.zh: 他生活在自己永远不会变老的错觉中。

derail.en: Fallen trees can derail a train if they block the tracks.
derail.zh: 倒下的树若挡住铁轨，可能使火车脱轨。

destine.en: Nothing can destine a person to failure forever.
destine.zh: 没有什么能注定一个人永远失败。

deterioration.en: Doctors worried about the rapid deterioration of his health.
deterioration.zh: 医生担心他的健康迅速恶化。

differentiation.en: Product differentiation helps companies stand out in the market.
differentiation.zh: 产品差异化帮助公司在市场中脱颖而出。

disproportionately.en: Poor families are disproportionately affected by rising food prices.
disproportionately.zh: 食品涨价对贫困家庭的影响格外不成比例。

drastically.en: The company drastically cut costs to avoid bankruptcy.
drastically.zh: 公司大幅削减成本以避免破产。

dwarf.en: In the fairy tale, a kind dwarf helps the lost child.
dwarf.zh: 童话里，一位善良的小矮人帮助了迷路的孩子。

dysfunction.en: Liver dysfunction can cause serious health problems.
dysfunction.zh: 肝功能失灵可能导致严重的健康问题。

energize.en: A short walk can energize you after a long meeting.
energize.zh: 开完长会后散散步能让你恢复精力。

entrepreneurship.en: The university offers a course on entrepreneurship for students.
entrepreneurship.zh: 这所大学为学生开设了创业管理课程。

esthetic.en: The museum values the esthetic beauty of modern design.
esthetic.zh: 博物馆重视现代设计的美学之美。

exceptional.en: She showed exceptional skill in solving hard math problems.
exceptional.zh: 她在解决难题时表现出非凡的能力。

fearlessly.en: The firefighter fearlessly entered the burning building.
fearlessly.zh: 消防员无畏地冲进了着火的大楼。

fertility.en: Good soil fertility helps farmers grow stronger crops.
fertility.zh: 良好的土壤肥力帮助农民种出更壮的庄稼。

firmness.en: She spoke with firmness when she refused the unfair offer.
firmness.zh: 她拒绝不公平的提议时语气坚定。

flux.en: The city population is in constant flux as people move in and out.
flux.zh: 随着人们迁入迁出，城市人口处于不断流动之中。

glider.en: The silent glider floated high above the green hills.
glider.zh: 那架无声的滑翔机在青山之上飘过。

gorilla.en: A large gorilla sat quietly in the forest shade.
gorilla.zh: 一只大猩猩安静地坐在森林阴凉处。

granite.en: The statue was carved from hard gray granite.
granite.zh: 这座雕像由坚硬的灰色花岗岩雕刻而成。

graphite.en: Pencils use graphite to leave marks on paper.
graphite.zh: 铅笔用石墨在纸上留下痕迹。

hack.en: Criminals tried to hack into the company's computer system.
hack.zh: 犯罪分子试图黑进公司的电脑系统。

handgun.en: Police found an illegal handgun in the abandoned car.
handgun.zh: 警方在废弃汽车里发现一把非法手枪。

herald.en: Dark clouds can herald the arrival of a storm.
herald.zh: 乌云可能预示着暴风雨的到来。

hull.en: Workers repaired a hole in the ship's steel hull.
hull.zh: 工人们修补了船体钢壳上的一个洞。

hurrah.en: Hurrah! Our team has finally won the match!
hurrah.zh: 好哇！我们队终于赢了比赛！

ideologically.en: The two parties are ideologically far apart on this issue.
ideologically.zh: 两党在这个问题上意识形态分歧很大。

immersive.en: The museum offers an immersive experience with virtual reality.
immersive.zh: 博物馆用虚拟现实提供身临其境的体验。

incur.en: Late payments will incur extra bank fees.
incur.zh: 逾期付款会产生额外的银行费用。

intensely.en: She studied intensely for three weeks before the exam.
intensely.zh: 考试前她紧张地复习了三周。

ion.en: An ion is an atom that carries an electric charge.
ion.zh: 离子是带有电荷的原子。

landmark.en: The court made a landmark decision on equal pay.
landmark.zh: 法院在同工同酬问题上作出了具有里程碑意义的裁决。

lathe.en: The worker shaped the metal part on a lathe.
lathe.zh: 工人在车床上加工出了这个金属零件。

lily.en: A white lily bloomed beside the garden pond.
lily.zh: 一朵白百合在花园池塘边开放。

literacy.en: Adult literacy programs help people learn to read and write.
literacy.zh: 成人识字项目帮助人们学习读写。

lobbyist.en: The lobbyist tried to persuade lawmakers to support the bill.
lobbyist.zh: 游说者试图说服议员支持该法案。

maneuver.en: The driver had to maneuver the car into a tiny parking space.
maneuver.zh: 司机不得不把车挪进一个很小的车位。

mast.en: A tall mast rose from the center of the sailing boat.
mast.zh: 帆船中央竖立着一根高高的桅杆。

module.en: This software module handles user login and passwords.
module.zh: 这个软件模块负责用户登录和密码。

narration.en: The film's narration is spoken by a famous actor.
narration.zh: 这部电影的旁白由一位著名演员讲述。

notoriously.en: The mountain road is notoriously dangerous in winter.
notoriously.zh: 这条山路在冬天出了名的危险。

obscurity.en: The poet lived in obscurity until her books became popular.
obscurity.zh: 这位诗人在作品走红之前一直默默无闻。

ohm.en: Resistance in this wire is about one ohm.
ohm.zh: 这根导线的电阻约为一欧姆。

overpass.en: Cars crossed the busy overpass above the railway lines.
overpass.zh: 汽车从铁路上方繁忙的立交桥上驶过。

oxide.en: Iron oxide is the red powder we usually call rust.
oxide.zh: 氧化铁就是我们通常所说的红色铁锈粉末。

panther.en: A black panther moved silently through the night forest.
panther.zh: 一只黑豹无声地穿过夜色中的森林。

pantry.en: She kept flour and rice in a small pantry next to the kitchen.
pantry.zh: 她把面粉和大米放在厨房旁的小食品柜里。

predestine.en: Some people believe fate can predestine a person's future.
predestine.zh: 有些人相信命运能注定一个人的未来。

preindustrial.en: Life in preindustrial villages depended heavily on farming.
preindustrial.zh: 工业化以前的乡村生活严重依赖农业。

premium.en: Workers received a cash premium for finishing early.
premium.zh: 工人因提前完工获得了现金奖金。

printer.en: The office printer ran out of paper before the meeting.
printer.zh: 开会前办公室的打印机没纸了。

propagation.en: The rapid propagation of the rumor worried the company.
propagation.zh: 谣言的迅速传播让公司感到担忧。

proximately.en: The two events occurred proximately in time, only minutes apart.
proximately.zh: 这两件事在时间上很接近，只隔了几分钟。

pumpkin.en: Children carved a big orange pumpkin for Halloween.
pumpkin.zh: 孩子们为万圣节刻了一个大南瓜。

purify.en: Special filters help purify drinking water in the village.
purify.zh: 特殊滤芯帮助净化村里的饮用水。

rating.en: The TV show received a high audience rating last night.
rating.zh: 昨晚这个电视节目获得了很高的收视率。

recruiter.en: A company recruiter called her about a new job opening.
recruiter.zh: 公司招聘人员就一个新职位给她打了电话。

reed.en: The musician played a soft tune on a thin reed.
reed.zh: 乐手用细细的芦笛吹奏出柔和的曲调。

refrain.en: Please refrain from talking during the exam.

reimbursement.en: She received full reimbursement for her train tickets.
reimbursement.zh: 她的火车票费用得到了全额报销。

reptile.en: A snake is a cold-blooded reptile that lays eggs.
reptile.zh: 蛇是产卵的冷血爬行动物。

retention.en: Water retention in the soil helps plants survive dry weeks.
retention.zh: 土壤保水有助于植物熬过干旱的几周。

rigor.en: Military training is known for its rigor and discipline.
rigor.zh: 军事训练以严格和纪律著称。

shepherd.en: Teachers shepherd new students through their first week.
shepherd.zh: 老师引导新生度过入学第一周。

shrank.en: The wool sweater shrank after it was washed in hot water.
shrank.zh: 这件羊毛衫用热水洗后缩水了。

simultaneously.en: The two singers began simultaneously and finished together.
simultaneously.zh: 两位歌手同时开始，又一起结束。

sofa.en: They sat on the sofa and watched a film together.
sofa.zh: 他们坐在沙发上一同看电影。

stern.en: Waves hit the stern of the boat during the storm.
stern.zh: 暴风雨中海浪拍打着船尾。

straightforward.en: Her answer was clear and straightforward.
straightforward.zh: 她的回答清晰而直截了当。

successively.en: He won the race three years successively.

tactics.en: The coach changed tactics at half-time.
tactics.zh: 教练在中场休息时改变了战术。

tape.en: Please tape the broken box before you ship it.
tape.zh: 寄出前请用胶带把破箱子粘好。

torque.en: The engine produces enough torque to climb steep hills.
torque.zh: 这台发动机产生的扭矩足以爬上陡坡。

tradeoff.en: There is always a tradeoff between speed and accuracy.
tradeoff.zh: 速度与准确性之间总存在权衡。

treasurer.en: The club treasurer keeps careful records of all spending.
treasurer.zh: 俱乐部财务主管仔细记录所有开支。

turbulence.en: The plane shook hard during the sudden turbulence.
turbulence.zh: 飞机在突如其来的气流中剧烈颠簸。

underrepresented.en: Women are still underrepresented in some science fields.
underrepresented.zh: 女性在某些科学领域的代表性仍然不足。

valuable.en: Please put each valuable in the hotel safe.
valuable.zh: 请把每件贵重物品放进酒店保险箱。

waitress.en: The waitress brought our drinks quickly and with a smile.
waitress.zh: 女服务员面带微笑很快端来了饮料。

willful.en: His willful refusal to listen caused more problems.
willful.zh: 他故意不肯听，导致了更多问题。

wrestle.en: The two athletes began a tough wrestle on the mat.
wrestle.zh: 两名运动员在垫子上开始了一场激烈的摔跤。
